doc.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Burned bridges with booking agents
summary: She burned bridges with agents over commissions but concedes agents who do not steal do not book you.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Did you ever feel that you burned any bridges that you regret on the business side?
Can you tell me about that.
Some of the booking agents I would burn the bridges, ‘cause I thought 10% of a dollar was a dime instead of sixty cents. But I understand, if they don’t steal, they won’t book you.
